_about: What's new: the released changes a member would notice, newest first, in plain words (src/ui/changelog.js draws them in a drawer). THE LIST IS EMPTY ON PURPOSE while the site is launching (owner, 1 Nov 2026): every entry point (the avatar menu row, the dashboard button and its New badge) renders only when this list holds at least one entry, so posting one brings them all back with no rebuild. Add new entries at the TOP: {id, date, title, items[]}; `id` is written into the device prefs blob (fms_studio_prefs_v1 `whatsNewSeen`) as the newest entry the reader has opened, so never reuse or rename one. Only what is on main and switched on for people.
